`excel_saved.bin` is the Excel-saved VBA project used by XlsxWriter's macro
example. It is a test fixture, not a seed for Counter Risk's shipped workbooks.

Source: https://github.com/jmcnamara/XlsxWriter/blob/af5927c110cf01571046a3138600f63b256ea89a/examples/vbaProject.bin
Example/provenance: https://github.com/jmcnamara/XlsxWriter/blob/af5927c110cf01571046a3138600f63b256ea89a/examples/macros.py
